basics.name: Priyanka Chatterjee
basics.label: Founding Full-Stack Engineer · React · Node.js · LLM Streaming Integration · 9,300★ Open-Source Contributor · 3.5+ Years

summaries.gcc-founding-fullstack: Full-stack engineer with 3.5+ years of experience in React, Node.js, database design, and LLM API integration with streaming responses, built across early-stage startups owning features end-to-end with no dedicated DevOps or QA team. Shipped an MCP server and multi-agent LLM tooling for Turbot HQ (9,300+ GitHub stars, 120+ merged PRs), cutting resource-discovery latency 70–90%.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
work.domainNote: Multi-cloud security and compliance software; makers of the open-source Steampipe/Powerpipe/Flowpipe/Tailpipe suite and the Turbot Guardrails PSPM platform.
highlights: Designed and built an internal REST API microservice in Go/Gin as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails, a PSPM SaaS product — an independent architectural call — secured with OAuth 2.0 (Auth0), containerized with Docker, and deployed to production on AWS EC2 with no dedicated DevOps team.
Built the Steampipe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server end to end in Python, giving LLM agents standardized, real-time access to enterprise cloud and security data for retrieval and analysis.

Designed a multi-agent workflow on the OpenAI Agents SDK orchestrating LLM agents that generate, validate, and self-correct cloud policy commands — hands-on LLM API integration and prompt design end to end.
Led the AWS SDK v2-to-v3 migration across 180+ call sites in production Node.js Lambdas, refactoring discovery and config-sync workflows; cut policy-code duplication ~60% via Nunjucks templating.

work.name: Trisetra, Inc.
work.domainNote: Early-stage Palo Alto startup building an AI-powered 3D product-visualization / interior-design SaaS.
highlights: Led the user-upload workflow redesign across 60+ files in React (Google Maps autocomplete, drag-and-drop upload, history dashboard) at an early-stage startup with no dedicated QA team, shipping full features independently.

projects.name: General-Purpose AI Chatbot / Agent (Model Context Protocol)
projects.description: Agentic chatbot/agent framework built with Pydantic AI featuring configurable external MCP servers via a persistent MongoDB-backed registry, JSON config loader with strict input validation, per-server failure isolation, native tool calling, mid-conversation multi-model switching (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Mistral), conversation-history persistence, sync + streaming output, prompt-injection safeguards, and Logfire observability.
